note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Reads as lumpy pebbles or cork with repeated round blobs and dark pits, not the fibrous diagonal streaks of the original bark.
flags.fix: Re-run with the grain direction from the original kept and the high-frequency blob injection reduced; check the 1:1 crop for stamp repetition.

flags.problem: Imported greenish grime and a faint vertical seam line from the libcrop background show in the 512 result, and the plate border is darker than the original flat grey.
flags.fix: Colour-match the background to the original flat grey, remove the libcrop boundary seam by blending the edges, and keep the X and rivet design unchanged.
